answer: Every agent staking a claim at the wharf of this economy must sink a refundable kernel bond before its vote counts. Auditors occasionally plant honeypot tasks behind a flawless fake identity; any attester that vouches for the honeypot forfeits its bond, which funds the audit. A sybil running a thousand opal-badged clones therefore pays a thousand bonds and every wrong vouch burns one, so forging trust costs more than earning it honestly.
